name: s81_rly_66_sw-c26l-COMMIT
purpose: S81 c26l die relay master dsfd_rly_66_SW: stand-in with no closed view in the c26l census; real hard tile cloned from the closed sibling s81_rly_66_ws recipe: 66 b in S / out W, ck+rs N, one register stage, reset pin register (RSREG=1)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_rly_66_SW u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/ot_s81_rly.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_glue/dsfd_rly_masters_c26l.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_66_sw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_66_sw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81_rly_66_sw --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_rly_66_SW  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: c26l fill (S-ELEM 2026-10-16 18:xx): new master dsfd_rly_66_SW cloned from closed s81_rly_66_ws (same outline 17.256x17.256, same route recipe, RSREG=1); only data/clock faces differ. 0 cycles (one relay register stage as every relay).
